verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for a government web portal, since public sites can offer cookie or analytics opt-outs. So the axis applies. The evidence only covers bot walls and unreadable robots.txt files on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov, which say nothing about telemetry or usage-tracking controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
